description: This file contains the server-side logic for the MCQExam page in an online examination system. It handles page loading, fetching questions from a database based on the course, displaying questions and options, managing timer countdown, and submitting the user's answers with scoring. The code interacts with session variables, updates the UI controls such as labels and radio button lists, and writes results back to the database.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the MCQExam ASP.NET page. Manages question loading, user interactions, timing, and result submission for the online exam.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Loads questions from the database into UI controls, initializes the timer based on exam time, and manages session state.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the user's score based on selected answers, stores the result in the database, and navigates to the results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles timeout when exam duration expires.
